angles: The ClawHavoc campaign of January 2026 triggered an explosion of agent security scanners — the market went from zero to 95+ tools in 6 months
NVIDIA SkillSpector dominates with 14K stars, but smaller specialized tools offer unique approaches (eBPF, formal verification, runtime proxies)
Shift from heuristic/pattern-matching scanners to formal verification (SkillFortify) and mathematical guarantees
Multi-layer detection is the emerging standard: static analysis + network heuristics + eBPF kernel monitoring + runtime proxy
EU AI Act compliance (August 2026 deadline) is a major driver — 97% of agent code reportedly non-compliant
Supply chain security for AI agents is becoming its own category, analogous to npm/PyPI security but for agent skills and MCP servers
Open source dominates the space — all major scanners are OSS (MIT/Apache-2.0), creating a community-driven security ecosystem
The distinction between 'agent scanner' (detecting agents in repos) and 'agent security scanner' (securing agents) is blurring
